list.name: datname
list.label: Database
list.query: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pg_postmaster_start_time()) AS uptime
SELECT current_setting('server_version') AS version
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) / current_setting('max_connections')::int, 1) AS used_pct FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'
SELECT count(*) AS active FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND backend_type = 'client backend' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(blks_hit) / NULLIF(sum(blks_hit) + sum(blks_read), 0), 2) AS hit_ratio FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname IN ($datname)

panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers. Aim for 99%+ on OLTP workloads. Counters are cumulative since the last stats reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size FROM pg_database WHERE datname IN ($datname)

panels.title: Rollback rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(xact_rollback) / NULLIF(sum(xact_commit) + sum(xact_rollback), 0), 2) AS rollback_pct FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname IN ($datname)

panels.description: High values usually mean application errors or retried transactions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(deadlocks), 0) AS deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname IN ($datname)
SELECT coalesce(state, 'unknown') AS state, count(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND datname IN ($datname) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Connections by user and application

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname AS database, usename AS "user", coalesce(nullif(application_name, ''), '(none)') AS application, count(*) AS connections, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') AS active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND datname IN ($datname) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY connections DESC

panels.description: Find which service is hogging connections. Many idle_in_tx is a red flag.

panels.title: What active queries are waiting on

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(wait_event_type, 'CPU / running') AS wait_type, coalesce(wait_event, '-') AS wait_event, count(*) AS sessions FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND backend_type = 'client backend' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.description: Lock = blocked by another session, IO = disk reads, Client = waiting for the app.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, datname AS database, usename AS "user", state, concat_ws(':', wait_event_type, wait_event) AS waiting_on, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - query_start)::float AS duration, left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND backend_type = 'client backend' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 20

panels.title: Idle in transaction

targets.rawSql: SELECT pid, datname AS database, usename AS "user", application_name AS application, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - state_change)::float AS idle_for, left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 150) AS last_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state LIKE 'idle in transaction%' AND datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY state_change LIMIT 20

panels.description: Open transactions doing nothing hold locks and block vacuum.

panels.title: Blocked queries

targets.rawSql: SELECT blocked.pid AS blocked_pid, blocked.usename AS blocked_user, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - blocked.query_start)::float AS waiting, left(regexp_replace(blocked.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 100) AS blocked_query, blocker.pid AS blocking_pid, blocker.usename AS blocking_user, left(regexp_replace(blocker.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 100) AS blocking_query FROM pg_stat_activity blocked CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(blocked.pid)) AS bp(pid) JOIN pg_stat_activity blocker ON blocker.pid = bp.pid WHERE blocked.datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY waiting DESC

panels.description: Empty means nothing is blocked right now.

panels.title: Databases

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname AS database, pg_database_size(datname) AS size, numbackends AS connections, xact_commit AS commits, xact_rollback AS rollbacks, round(100.0 * blks_hit / NULLIF(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 2) AS cache_hit_pct, deadlocks, temp_files, temp_bytes, conflicts, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY size DESC

panels.description: temp_files / temp_bytes growing means queries spill to disk: consider raising work_mem or adding indexes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname AS database, pg_database_size(datname) AS size FROM pg_database WHERE datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY size DESC

panels.title: Transaction ID age (% towards wraparound)

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname AS database, round(100.0 * age(datfrozenxid) / 2147483647, 2) AS wraparound_pct FROM pg_database WHERE datname IN ($datname) ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Autovacuum should keep this near 10%. Above 50% means vacuum is failing to freeze rows: investigate immediately.

panels.title: Tables & indexes (database selected in the data source)

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname AS schema, relname AS "table", pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS total_size, pg_relation_size(relid) AS table_size, pg_indexes_size(relid) AS index_size, n_live_tup AS live_rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY total_size DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Vacuum health

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname AS "table", n_live_tup AS live, n_dead_tup AS dead, round(100.0 * n_dead_tup / NULLIF(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup, 0), 1) AS dead_pct, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze, autovacuum_count FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Dead tuples are rows waiting to be cleaned up. High dead_pct = bloat; check autovacuum settings.

panels.title: Tables read by sequential scan (missing index candidates)

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname AS "table", n_live_tup AS rows, seq_scan, seq_tup_read, coalesce(idx_scan, 0) AS idx_scan FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE seq_scan > coalesce(idx_scan, 0) AND n_live_tup > 10000 ORDER BY seq_tup_read DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Large tables that are scanned in full more often than via an index.

panels.title: Unused indexes

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.schemaname || '.' || s.relname AS "table", s.indexrelname AS index, pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) AS size, s.idx_scan FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid WHERE s.idx_scan = 0 AND NOT i.indisunique AND NOT i.indisprimary ORDER BY pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Indexes never used since stats reset. They cost disk and slow writes. Check the stats age before dropping.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, setting || coalesce(' ' || unit, '') AS value FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('max_connections','shared_buffers','work_mem','maintenance_work_mem','effective_cache_size','max_wal_size','autovacuum','random_page_cost','log_min_duration_statement') ORDER BY name

panels.title: Checkpoints

targets.rawSql: SELECT num_timed, num_requested, round(100.0 * num_requested / NULLIF(num_timed + num_requested, 0), 1) AS requested_pct, buffers_written, write_time, sync_time FROM pg_stat_checkpointer

panels.description: requested_pct high = checkpoints forced by WAL volume: raise max_wal_size. (PostgreSQL 17+)

panels.title: Replication slots

targets.rawSql: SELECT slot_name, slot_type, active, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), restart_lsn) AS retained_wal FROM pg_replication_slots

panels.description: Inactive slots keep WAL forever and can fill the disk. Empty means no slots exist.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS query, calls, round(total_exec_time::numeric, 0) AS total_ms, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, rows, round(100.0 * shared_blks_hit / NULLIF(shared_blks_hit + shared_blks_read, 0), 1) AS cache_hit_pct FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS query, calls, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_ms, round(max_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS max_ms, round(stddev_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS stddev_ms, rows FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND calls >= 10 AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 15
